messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Elevated 502 rate and latency spike on the 'low-latency' lane in us-west. Affecting mostly bronze/free tier. ~10% failure rate observed. Paging SRE oncall.

Tia (oncall): On it. grabbing logs now. any immediate customer reports?

Maya (Product Ops): Support seeing a handful of PLG customers timing out in login flows — ~5 distinct orgs reported. No major bill impact yet but user-facing.

Mike H: Quick mitigation idea — soft-steer bronze (free) traffic from us-west to the cost-optimized lane (eu-west preference) to relieve the overloaded low-latency lane. Keep fallback to low-latency if latency goes bad.

Zoe L: I can push a routing policy to do that. also suggest a temporary per-org quota for bronze to avoid hammering the target lane.

EngRuntime: Pushing a policy CLI prototype now:
```
redwood routes apply --policy-name regional-lane-stitch \
  --match 'tier==bronze && region==us-west' \
  --prefer 'lane:cost-1,latency_sla:300' \
  --fallback 'lane:low-latency'
```
(we'll canary at 10%)

Tia (oncall): Applying canary to 10% of bronze traffic now. watching 502, p95.

incident-bot: DEPLOY: policy regional-lane-stitch rolled to canary (10%) — started 15:42 UTC.

Mike H: Observability owners — watch 502 rate, p95 latency, and cost delta. If errors creep >1% revert.

Zoe L: Canary looks good after 10m — affected keys 502s dropped from 9.8% -> 1.4%. p95 latency +30ms on those requests. moving to 50%.

Maya (Product Ops): Notified support. flagged customers A123, A456 to proactively check UX. rollback playbook ready.

Tia (oncall): Increasing to 50% now. also applying temporary quota cap for bronze: 200 req/min/org.

EngRuntime: Quota command:
```
redwood quotas set --tier bronze --max-per-org 200
```

incident-bot: ALERT: quota change applied. Monitoring for 429.

Mike H: Seeing expected small uptick in 429s — holding. tradeoff looks acceptable given drop in 502s.

Zoe L: 50% stable for 20m. ramping to 100% in 5m if metrics hold.

Tia (oncall): Going to 100% now. keeping bronze quotas and extended trace sampling on these keys for 1h. opening a follow-up ticket for root cause.

Maya (Product Ops): Customer impact summary: most customers recovered; support following up with those 5 orgs. no retroactive credits planned at this time.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: routing policy regional-lane-stitch at 100% and bronze quotas applied. Follow-up: retro scheduled in #postmortems tomorrow 10:00 UTC. 

(react: :white_check_mark: from Tia, :eyes: from Mike H)
